Will I get a replacement or a refund?

Sent · Just now

Camilla Angel Bot · AI

Camilla Angel Bot · AI says:

Whether you receive a replacement or a refund depends on the situation:

Faulty items:
Minor fault: we may repair the product where possible.
Major fault: you can choose a replacement product or a refund of the original purchase amount.
Wrong item received: once validated via our Returns Portal, we will organize a correction (this may involve replacement of the item).
Out-of-stock items: you’ll receive a full refund to your original payment method.
Exchanges online: we currently do not exchange online orders; in many online cases, you’ll be refunded instead once the return is processed.

So you may get a replacement, repair, or refund, depending on whether the issue is a minor/major fault, a wrong item, or an out-of-stock situation.
